sn48.40:1.1: Here the faculties are correlated with the absorptions. Though some correlations are obscure, this passage highlights the connection between the feelings and the practice of the path.
sn48.40:1.4: They experience pain in the body while meditating.
sn48.40:1.6: Here _nimitta_ clearly means “basis”, as also at eg. [an2.77]().
